FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Shutter & Snap Photo Supply, we specialize in providing a wide range of camera and photo supplies, including cameras, lenses, accessories, and studio lighting. Our operations are primarily focused on retail sales, both in-store and online, catering to photography enthusiasts, professionals, and casual users alike. We prioritize exceptional customer service, employing knowledgeable staff who are passionate about photography. Our commitment to quality ensures that we offer only trusted brands and products. We also host educational workshops and classes to help customers enhance their photography skills, all while maintaining compliance with local business regulations and fire safety standards. We do not engage in any processing of hazardous materials or offer drone-related services, ensuring a safe and streamlined shopping experience for our customers.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 05/12/2022, a water pipe burst in the storage area, resulting in damage to inventory including cameras and accessories. The estimated loss amounted to $1,200. The claim was processed, and the status is closed.
